integrity: Exact polynomial and module arguments; independent external audit not performed. Finite field verification is corroborative, not an infinite-field certificate.
scientific_limitations: Affine reduced discriminant of monic quintics in characteristic two; projective quotient, resolution, test ideals and full inseparable boundary type not established. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Normalization and embedded Jacobian structure of the reduced characteristic-two quintic discriminant
